method.scope: Fixed retrieval stub, real local generation and critic; source starts at document offset 100.
method.positions: Control at start, two facts after 1500 characters, missing-answer control.
method.changes: Same model routing, prompts, generation/critic deadlines; query-aware window and citation mapping changed.
caveats: Four synthetic cases per arm, one pass per case; not a general accuracy percentage.
Not real PDF/EPUB parsing, vector recall, or UI click-through acceptance.
Exact source/offset checks do not prove arbitrary claims are semantically entailed.
Generating an answer can take longer than returning insufficient evidence.
Merged-source gap mapping covered by unit tests, not real-model cases.
